vectors.name: page-full
vectors.note: Exactly 1024 entries; each 01 + SHA-256(chunk-a envelope) + 0000000000000001. Repetition is intentional.

vectors.name: manifest-empty
vectors.note: Empty file: no pages and raw empty SHA-256.

vectors.name: manifest-new
vectors.note: asset.bin revision 2: new root; old root/page unchanged.

vectors.name: manifest-1025
vectors.note: 1025 references: full page plus one-entry final page.

vectors.name: manifest-repeated-page
vectors.note: Same immutable full page reused twice in sequence.

vectors.name: tree-empty
vectors.note: Payload equals chunk-tree-payload; envelope kind yields distinct IDs.

vectors.name: tree-old
vectors.note: Same pathname as tree-new; independent earlier revision.

vectors.name: tree-unicode
vectors.note: Sorted UTF-8 paths, executable mode, empty file.

vectors.name: commit-root
vectors.note: Root commit: parents[] empty and epoch timestamp.

vectors.name: commit-merge
vectors.note: Ordered parents: new first, side second.

vectors.name: commit-merge-reversed
vectors.note: Same parent set, reversed order changes identity.

vectors.name: commit-64-parents
vectors.note: Maximum 64 distinct parents, preserved in order.

vectors.name: tag-annotated
vectors.note: Native commit-targeted annotation with UTF-8 message.

vectors.name: offer-v1
vectors.note: Valid offer but no v2 intersection.

vectors.name: offer-missing-feature
vectors.note: Valid offer unable to satisfy format-2 requirements.

vectors.name: selection-v2
vectors.note: Highest mutually supported version is 2 on both axes.

vectors.name: ref-head-cas
vectors.note: Exact typed expected old ID. Schema only; no CAS implementation.

vectors.name: bad-magic
vectors.note: A v1/other version is not v2.

vectors.name: trailing-byte
vectors.note: A record consumes all supplied bytes.

vectors.name: chunk-oversized-header
vectors.note: Reject length before trying to read or allocate payload.

vectors.name: wrong-pinned-address
vectors.note: Valid content does not match requested address.

vectors.name: uppercase-text-id
vectors.note: No uppercase or alias ID spellings.

vectors.name: page-empty
vectors.note: Empty file uses zero root pages, not empty pages.

vectors.name: page-zero-chunk
vectors.note: Manifest entries cannot reference empty chunks.

vectors.name: page-chunk-size-mismatch
vectors.note: Declared chunk length differs from raw payload.

vectors.name: page-1025-count
vectors.note: Reject count before allocation; 1024 is the maximum.

vectors.name: page-wrong-link-kind
vectors.note: A tree link is not a chunk.

vectors.name: manifest-wrong-page-length
vectors.note: Root page length must match resolved page.

vectors.name: manifest-wrong-checksum
vectors.note: Same file length, wrong raw-byte checksum.

vectors.name: manifest-empty-wrong-checksum
vectors.note: Empty checksum is SHA-256(empty), not zeros.

vectors.name: manifest-missing-page
vectors.note: Valid root bytes without dependency closure.

vectors.name: tree-path-traversal
vectors.note: Never normalize dot-dot into a safe path.

vectors.name: tree-file-descendant
vectors.note: Ancestor conflict even with an intervening sorted entry.

vectors.name: tree-invalid-utf8
vectors.note: Reject invalid UTF-8, no replacement character rewrite.

vectors.name: tree-control-path
vectors.note: LF permitted in messages, not paths.

vectors.name: tree-overlong-path
vectors.note: Path-specific bound is stricter than generic text.

vectors.name: commit-duplicate-parent
vectors.note: Parents are ordered distinct links, not a multiset.

vectors.name: commit-65-count
vectors.note: Parent count limit checked before read.

vectors.name: commit-tree-wrong-kind
vectors.note: Tree link must not be a file manifest.

vectors.name: commit-missing-parent
vectors.note: Missing history is not a root commit.

vectors.name: tag-tree
vectors.note: Typed tree target preserved, not implicitly peeled to a commit.

vectors.name: tag-nested
vectors.note: Nested annotation target preserved as a typed tag link.

vectors.name: ref-tag-name-mismatch
vectors.note: Annotation name and ref suffix must agree.

vectors.name: ref-bad-presence
vectors.note: Presence is exactly zero or one.

vectors.name: offer-unsorted
vectors.note: Version order is canonical, not preference order.

vectors.name: offer-no-formats
vectors.note: At least one supported format required.

vectors.name: selection-format-v1
vectors.note: Format axis selected independently; only format 2 defined here.

vectors.name: selection-protocol-v1
vectors.note: Protocol axis also must be supported.

vectors.name: selection-missing-required
vectors.note: Cannot omit a required format feature.

vectors.name: selection-unoffered-feature
vectors.note: Selected feature must be offered by both peers.

vectors.name: marker-v2
vectors.note: Exact future repository marker, not an automatic migration.

vectors.name: marker-v1-explicit
vectors.note: Not a valid v2 marker; absence denotes legacy v1.

vectors.name: commit-min-time
vectors.note: Minimum signed 64-bit Unix second, no platform date conversion.

vectors.name: commit-minus-zero
vectors.note: Negative zero UTC offset spelling remains identity-significant.

vectors.name: tag-file-manifest
vectors.note: File tag pins immutable revision root, not pathname.

vectors.name: tag-chunk
vectors.note: Raw chunk target allowed; no implicit file interpretation.

vectors.name: tag-page
vectors.note: All native typed target kinds are representable.

vectors.name: tag-unknown-target-kind
vectors.note: Unknown object kinds still fail closed.

vectors.name: ref-lightweight-file-tag
vectors.note: Lightweight tag can target a non-commit object.
